rules.label: First Half
rules.text: Increases Lunar-Crystallize damage by 75%, favoring Geo and crystallize-focused teams.

rules.label: Second Half
rules.text: Grants all party members +200 Elemental Mastery (EM), boosting reaction-based damage

enc.name: Battle-Hardened Prism Slime ×2
enc.mech: Two high-HP targets. Group damage where possible; the first-half Lunar-Crystallize bonus rewards Hydro + Geo teams.

enc.name: Wavebinder: Stormfang
enc.mech:
Drinking builds Courage; Electro DMG drains it.
Stellar Glimmer Electro reactions drain more Courage.
Apply Radiance: Stellar Glimmer while it drinks to slow Courage buildup.
Full Courage grants a shield and increased RES.
Depleting Courage removes the shield and deals massive backlash DMG.

enc.name: Frostnight Herra
enc.mech:
At half HP: channeled attacks and an element-absorbing gauge
Fill the gauge to stop the channel
Then becomes immune to the element that filled it most

enc.name: Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow
enc.mech:
Cryo shield appears around 80% HP (up to twice)
Shield not broken in 20s = it heals 10%
Breaking the shield lowers its RES for 10s

enc.name: Radiant Moongecko
enc.mech:
Geo shield bars (tail lights up with Geo)
Breaking shield bars also hurts its HP
Radiant Cocoon: more damage taken, no crits, less healing

enc.name: Perpetual Mechanical Array
enc.mech:
Shield goes up; four mini-sentinels appear
Kill the sentinels to break the shield
Laser beams and slams

bosses.name: Wavebinder: Stormfang
bosses.mech:
Drinking builds Courage; Electro DMG drains it.
Stellar Glimmer Electro reactions drain more Courage.
Apply Radiance: Stellar Glimmer while it drinks to slow Courage buildup.
Full Courage grants a shield and increased RES.
Depleting Courage removes the shield and deals massive backlash DMG.
bosses.beat:
Prioritize Electro DMG to drain Courage.
Trigger Stellar Glimmer reactions for faster Courage reduction.
Apply Radiance: Stellar Glimmer while it drinks to slow Courage buildup.
Avoid wasting your strongest attacks against its shield.
Once Valiant Assault ends, unleash your strongest attacks during its backlash window.

bosses.name: Emperor of Fire and Iron
bosses.mech:
Pyro horns grant the boss massive RES to all elements.



Horns have greatly increased durability in Stygian Onslaught.



Sternshield Crabs can appear during the fight.



Watch for Radiant Coronation, a powerful AoE attack.
bosses.beat:
Bring a strong Hydro applicator to break the Pyro horns.



Focus on the horns before attacking the boss.



Once broken, the boss is stunned and loses its RES boost.



Use the stun window to unleash your strongest attacks.



Watch your positioning to avoid AoE attacks and crab pressure.

bosses.name: Radiant Moongecko
bosses.mech:
Geo shield has 18 layers on Dire; Geo and blunt attacks break it.



Shield break stuns the boss and lowers Geo RES from 70% to 10%.



Radiant Cocoon drains HP and reduces Crit Rate by 100%.



Healing everyone to 100% removes the debuff and grants 15% Crit Rate and 50% DMG.



Moonstone Anchor wards must be destroyed within 20 seconds or the boss gains 30% ATK.
bosses.beat:
Bring Geo or blunt attacks to break the shield quickly.



Use a strong team-wide healer to restore everyone to 100% HP.



Heal through Radiant Cocoon to remove the Crit Rate debuff and gain its damage bonus.



Destroy all Moonstone Anchor wards within 20 seconds.



Save your strongest attacks for the shield-break stun window.

enc.name: Jadeplume Terrorshroom
enc.mech:
Electro fills its Activation/Fury gauge
Pyro reduces Activation — avoid it even if using a Special Guest
At full Activation, it unleashes an empowered attack sequence
Afterwards, it becomes paralyzed with reduced RES, creating your big DPS window
enc.beat:
Spam Electro → Fill Fury → Survive its empowered attack → BURST during paralysis.

Don't waste your strongest roster here. The entire gimmick actually helps you kill it. Feed it Electro until it goes berserk, dodge the attack, then unload while it's exhausted.

enc.name: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares
enc.mech:
Shield Phase: Summons 4 Fishers; each defeated removes 25% of its shield.
Lunar Reactions: Effective for breaking the shield.
Shield Break: Deals 20% Max HP damage, reduces RES by 70%, and stuns for 10s.
Shield Failure: Triggers a powerful arena-wide Electro attack.
enc.beat:
Use Lunar reactions or defeat all 4 Fishers to break the shield.
Save Bursts for the stunned phase.
Unleash your strongest rotation during the 70% RES reduction.
Dodge teleport strikes and tail sweeps.

enc.name: Churldric, Ladler of Broth
enc.mech:
Summons a Cooking Pot and begins his ritual
The pot counts as a Geo object and is particularly weak to Blunt attacks
You have roughly 16 seconds before the cooking resolves
Destroying the pot damages Churldric, stuns him and reduces ALL RES by 50% during the stun
enc.beat:
Pot appears → IGNORE CHURLDRIC → Destroy pot → Churldric gets stunned → BURST HIM.

Hydro or Electro can extinguish the pot's flame and slow the cooking mechanic, but destroying the pot is what you really want because it gives you the huge vulnerability window.

enc.name: Radiant Moonfly
enc.mech:
Uses Radiant Cocoon, damaging your party and debuffing affected characters
Cocoon gives −100% CRIT Rate, −50% DMG Bonus and −40% Incoming Healing
Healing a character back to 100% HP removes the Cocoon
Breaking free grants Disentangled: +15% CRIT Rate & +50% DMG Bonus for 15s
enc.beat:
Radiant Cocoon → HEAL TO 100% ASAP → Gain Disentangled → BURST.
Move away when you see the Dendro Razor
Heal to full to break the Cocoon
Lunar-Bloom or Hyperbloom work well; bring sustain

enc.name: Consecrated Fanged Beast
enc.mech:
Empowered state increases resistance.
Aggressive elemental attacks deal heavy damage.
Special attacks spawn elemental energy blocks.
Destroy blocks to stun beasts and deal bonus damage.
enc.beat:
Destroy energy blocks immediately.
Match the block's element for an instant break.
Burst during the paralysis window.
Dodge combos and prioritize survival.

enc.name: Biting-Cold Wayob Manifestation
enc.mech:
Cryo beams and X-shaped hailstone attacks.
Arena drains Energy and prevents Energy gain.
Ward grants immunity to damage.
Failed shield break triggers a powerful Cryo blast.
enc.beat:
Break the ward before the arena expires.
Dodge X-shaped hailstone patterns.
Use Bursts before Energy Drain.
Break the ward to stun for 5 seconds.
